name: Automate a Booking or Checkout Flow
description: Automate a multi-step booking, reservation, or checkout flow end-to-end — select, fill details, choose options, confirm — with a hard dry-run/confirmation guard so it never accidentally commits a real transaction during development. Maps the step-by-step flow, the success/failure signals, and the safety guard FIRST, then builds the resilient step driver with waits and retries, then tests both the happy path and the failure/abort paths against a stub or dry-run. Mapping-the-flow-and-guard-before-build is what makes booking automation safe and reliable instead of a brittle, money-spending click bot.
